images.title: Anchor text that does its job
images.alt: Checklist for internal link anchor text: passes the read-it-alone test, varied wording, text between links, alt text on image links, standard HTML links.
images.caption: Read the anchor on its own. If it still tells you what's behind the link, it's fine.

items: Makes sense with the rest of the sentence removed
Descriptive, reasonably concise and relevant to both pages
Worded to fit each sentence, not one repeated keyword
Some text between links so each keeps its context
A standard HTML link with an href, not a JavaScript button

images.title: The 30-minute link audit
images.alt: Five steps of an internal link audit: export Search Console data, find gaps, pick five pages, add links, then check and note changes.
images.caption: Give Google a few weeks to recrawl before judging the results.

items.title: Export the data (5 min)
items.text: Export the internal Top linked pages table from Search Console's Links report

items.title: Find the gaps (5 min)
items.text: Sort lowest first and mark pages with very few links or none listed

items.title: Pick five pages (5 min)
items.text: Choose the five that matter most; skip thin or outdated posts

items.title: Add the links (10 min)
items.text: Run a site: search for each topic and add one in-sentence link to 2 or 3 posts

items.title: Check and note (5 min)
items.text: Click every new link, then write down the date and the pages you changed

images.title: Internal linking mistakes to fix
images.alt: Four common internal linking mistakes: the same anchor everywhere, links only in menus or widgets, pages linking to themselves, and nofollow internal links.
images.caption: Older posts often carry most of your traffic, so go back and add links to newer pages too.

items.title: Same anchor everywhere
items.text: "Read more" says nothing; one repeated keyword phrase looks forced

items.title: Menu and footer only
items.text: Use them as a backstop; put the links that matter in body text

items.title: A page linking to itself
items.text: Often from auto-linking plugins, and it sends the reader nowhere

items.title: Nofollow on your own links
items.text: Some themes add it; check a few links in your page source
